_doc: Singing faces ('face build'): the mouth shapes drawn from a face image. w = width and h = opening, as fractions of the face's own mouth width (h 0 = closed lips); round = an O-like ring; teeth = top/both rows of teeth; tongue = tongue showing (L); lip = lower lip under the teeth (FV); thick = extra line thickness for pressed lips (MBP); beyond = how many pixels an open mouth may go past the pixels you marked (0.24.25: 1 for the widest - AI, O, U, L; up and down shows most). With marked pixels, the open shapes use the marked height (h 0.5 or more: all of it). phonemes: how sung words become mouth shapes for the seqtool-lyrics timing track (its phoneme layer) - dictionaries are tried in order: "cmudict" (the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary, downloaded once on first use) or a path to a file in the same format (e.g. xLights' standard_dictionary); your own pronunciations go in seqtool-prefs/pronunciations.dict (or the file given with --dictionary), checked first; mapping = ARPAbet sound -> mouth shape. sing: props given a face ('face use PROP FACE'; singing is the reaction preset 'sing' since 0.24.0, so it can be set per section - 'react PROP sing @#3') sing each lyric line (of their voice: {VOICE} codes in the lyrics, 'face use ... --voice'), from lead seconds before to tail after, lines closer than join seconds joined; mode alone = the prop's other layers rest meanwhile, over = the face on top of them (the eyes keep xLights' default, Auto: they blink).
